axes.concept: Inspect the paid calls behind a spend group while preserving project and conversation attribution.
axes.layout: One working paper with a shared filter strip, a 330px left register and fluid right inspector; phone uses one active list or detail pane.
axes.navigation: Local group-by navigation for session, work item, user, kind and tool; pressed register rows drive the adjacent inspector and phone back restores row focus.
axes.typography: Production Geist Sans, 24px page title, 20px group title, 28px selected amount, 12–13px metadata; existing Geist Mono for identifiers and models.
axes.density: 28px desktop and 20px phone paper insets, ruled 18px register rows and 20px call spacing; progressive disclosure for attribution and remaining calls.
axes.components: Real installed shadcn/Base UI Button and Skeleton with native selects/details and custom register/inspector arrangements; sibling rounded panels and pill controls.
axes.colour: Exact Pictures light/dark tokens mapped to kit roles; neutral navigation, existing primary focus and warning tokens only for partial/error records.
axes.motion: Spatial inspector seating from +22px through −2px; left register rows and vertical call settling, 460/300/160ms profile timing, 45ms offsets and cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1); still/reduced parity and hidden-tab pause.
